scope: Resolve confirmed project follow-ups and qualify concurrent upload fixes; preserve UI and unrelated edits.

resolutions.summary: Workflow runtime ports carry user/workspace/thread/message, job origin and combined cancellation. Host model/tool dispatch checks the active job, live execution message, fresh write access and canonical ownership; tools recheck before delivery. Missing origins refuse.
Filesystem reserves atomic upload quota before signing; commit consumes the matching intent before publishing the sidecar. Failed consumption/sidecar publication can retry.
S3 consumes the bound intent before marker publication and reconciles matching markers after conditional-write conflicts. Mismatched tuples refuse.

Native SQLite and D1 retain consumed quota during valid receipt authorization until canonical metadata arrives. Exact replay cannot outlive original expiry. Convex commits canonical metadata and consumes the intent within its mutation.
resolutions.scope: Logical live metadata plus unexpired pending authorizations, as documented by providers; not retained physical disk usage.

resolutions.summary: Nested project saves defer post/reference notifications to the outermost Dexie commit outside its transaction context. They return without waiting for the outer commit; rollbacks emit nothing.
Unresolved canonical ownership refuses server tools/workflows, including older providers. The warning-only fallback was removed. Provider/backend upgrades are required before retrying.
Legacy project scans remain an unmeasured very-large-workspace risk. No speculative schema/index migration.
